description: This file contains test cases for the failover policy logic, specifically testing the functions 'resolveRunFailoverDecision' and 'mergeRetryFailoverReason'. It uses the Vitest testing framework to validate how different failover scenarios are handled in the system.

methods.name: resolveRunFailoverDecision
methods.description: Determines the action to take during a failover based on the current stage and context, such as retry, prompt, or assistant stages.

methods.name: mergeRetryFailoverReason
methods.description: Merges previous and current failover reasons, prioritizing timeout and preserving existing reasons.
